Art-rock art-song chamber-pop with prime-limit lattice tuning and co-prime cycle interlock. Harmony: bitonal quartal suspension fields with microtonal pure intervals rubbing against tempered glass. Melody: angular patter singing with yodel register flips and hocketed vowel fragments. Rhythm: 3:2 coupling with gradual phase shift and intermittent silent breath hockets. Timbre: wet glass harmonica, bowed vibraphone, musical saw, ondes martenot, and cristal baschet in concentric spatial rings. Performance: cheap trashy spectacle meets obsessive fixated urgency, highly theatrical, trashy hyper-confident delivery, screaming and massed antiphonal choir counterpoint, ecstatic kinetic energy, continuous forward propulsion, relentless pressure across every harmonic partial.

Wake up you dumb whore!

Wake up you dumb whore!

Wake up you dumb whore!

Wake up you dumb whore!

Wake up you dumb whore!
[CRISTAL BASCHET RODS RUBBED WITH METAL RESONATORS]
We measured the precise distance from your left eyelid to the collapsing economy of meaning.
Wake up you dumb whore!
[ONDES MARTENOT DIFFUSER COLOR SHIFT]
It is somehow closer to a broken toaster than a legitimate tragedy!
[BRIDGE — CO-PRIME CYCLE INTERLOCK 5 AND 7 STEPS UNCOILING]
[GRADUAL PHASE SHIFT IN FULL EFFECT]
[LOOP FERRET FEEDBACK CIRCUIT CLOSURE]
When the structural loop returns, it brings a much better question.
Wake up you dumb whore!

Wake up you dumb whore!
[CHOIR POSSESSION — CHOIR TAKES OVER BASS RHYTHM]
[STAMPING AND BODY PERCUSSION HOCKET]
Wake! Wake! Wake! Wake!
[PRE-CHORUS — MAXIMUM KINETIC VELOCITY]
[GROUP INHALE TRIGGER]
[BOWED VIBRAPHONE AND GLASS HARMONICA PEAK OVERTONES]
Absolute trashy confidence! Zero shame in the geometry of the fall!
Wake up you dumb whore!
[CHORUS — PERPETUAL UPLIFT — DUAL RHYTHMIC TRUTHS ALIGNED]
[CHOIR GROUP A AND B IN HYPER-DENSE ANTHIPHONAL OVERLAP]
Wake up you dumb whore!
Wake up you dumb whore!
[PRISMATIC SPECTRAL COPIES SPLITTING ACROSS THREE PAN LOCATIONS]
Hear the glass shatter into traceable color across the back wall!
Wake up you dumb whore!
[OUTRO — GRADUAL PHASE RESET AND DECAY]
[GLASS HARMONICA LONG BELL-LIKE SUSTAIN]
[MUSICAL SAW SINKING GLISSANDO]
Wake up...
You dumb...
Whore...
